messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT P1 — Route53 routing anomalies detected in eu-west-1. Multiple ELB target groups showing rapid healthcheck flaps and cross-AZ request skew. Pager routed to on-call infra + SRE.

alice: Paging in — seeing a sharp 5xx spike from our inference edge ELBs in eu-west-1c (~30% errors at peak). Grafana: latency + downstream timeout errors to targets.

ben: i'm on. Correlating with route53: increased SERVFAIL/latency for resolver pool servicing eu-west-1 -> noticed TTLs still valid but weighted records shifting.

carol: customer ops getting tickets complaining about slow /generate and timeouts. Large customers A and B reporting degraded throughput. Drafting comms now.

alice: dug into ELB target groups: TG-ml-euw1 has ~40% targets UNHEALTHY in az-1 and az-2, but az-3 mostly ok. ENI metrics show packet loss spikes on a subset of hosts.

ben: running quick aws cli checks:
```
aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:tg:ml-euw1 | jq '.TargetHealthDescriptions[] | {Id: .Target.Id, State: .TargetHealth.State, Reason: .TargetHealth.Reason}'
# sample output: UNHEALTHY -> "Health checks failed: timeout" on 7/18 hosts
```

dave: checking EC2/eni side: seeing RX/TX drops and elevated retransmits on ENI attachments in eu-west-1b. No EBS io errors yet. Could be noisy NIC firmware or host-level networking. Opening host-level console.

eve-support: customers A/B notified: "We're investigating increased errors in eu-west-1; routing mitigations in progress, we'll update within 30m." (sending from support hub) :envelope_with_arrow:

ben: hypothesis — regional edge fabric (or upstream provider) is causing asymmetric reachability; Route53 health checks are reporting flaps because some healthcheck origins are timing out. Immediate mitigation options: weight-shift Route53 to eu-west-2, enable failover records, and scale up healthy AZs.

alice: agree. I'll prepare an opt-in weight shift to eu-west-2 as controlled failover (start 10% -> 50% -> 90%). Need approvals from SRE and product for cross-region degrade.

carol: @alice please include customer impact note and expected ETA for fallback. I'll post a status banner when we hit 50%.

ben: executing a scripted route53 change (manual staged weights). Command (will run once folks ack):
```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z1234 --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood.ai.","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"eu-west-2-priority","Weight":10,"Region":"eu-west-2","TTL":60}}]}'
```

alice: ack. i'll do canary weight shift to 10% now. notifying downstream traffic engineers.

incident-bot: Incident timeline note created. Pager duty ack by alice.

ben: 10% weight shift applied. monitoring error rate.

~3m later~

alice: error rate dropped from 30% -> 18% after 10% shift. still elevated but trending. continuing to 50% if health remains stable for 5m.

dave: concurrently, isolating hosts with noisy ENIs and draining targets from TG-ml-euw1 on those hosts to reduce error propagation. Running:
```
aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:tg:ml-euw1 --targets Id=i-0abcde12345
# draining -> wait for in-flight requests
```

carol: posting update to customers: "We have started routing a portion of traffic to eu-west-2; we expect reduced errors. We'll confirm when 50% shift completes."

ben: moving to 50% weight now. Observability: 5xxs down to 7% (from 30%). Requests per second steady.

alice: good. continue drain + replace problematic hosts in eu-west-1b. opening AWS support ticket (case #123456789) to investigate fabric/host networking.

eve-support: communication updated: second update posted. customers asked to open severity tickets if still impacted.

~20m later~

ben: after 90% weight shift and host replacements, error rate stabilized around 1.2%, latency back to normal. ELB target group health converging.

dave: EBS and EC2 control plane show no throttling. Looks isolated to host networking on a subset of hypervisors in eu-west-1b. AWS case escalated to networking team.

alice: rollback plan ready — we'll return traffic gradually once AWS confirms host-level repairs. For now we'll keep eu-west-2 weight at 80% for extra safety.

carol: prepping incident channel for postmortem: collecting traces, traceback of affected customers, and timeline. ETA for postmortem draft 48 hours.

eve-support: customers notified: issue mitigated, working on root cause and long-form postmortem. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident severity -> P1 -> mitigated. Tracking postmortem task created in tracker: DOC-789.

alice: handing off to ben for overnight monitoring and postmortem ownership. ben — you're next oncall for this incident.

ben: taking handoff. i'll run a final sweep of canaries and keep a watch window for 4 hours. ping me in #incidents if anything regresses. :eyes:

carol: thanks team. great coord.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from dave, :clap: from eve-support)
